Sam Liu: Need 2x LGTM for hotfix-2026 before 18:00 UTC cutoff. PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8210 — pinging reviewers. If we miss cutoff we postpone to next window.
Ava Patel: On it, will skim in ~10m :eyes:
Morgan Chen: I can do second pass after Ava — scheduling a quick review now.
John Reyes: Heads up CI showing a smoke failure on staging, looking into logs.
CI Bot: build #4721 failed — failing test: runtime.tests.test_kv_cache::test_async_warmup
CI Bot: logs:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 0 entries, got 3
.../tests/test_kv_cache.py:48
```
Sam Liu: Thanks John. If this is flaky we can either re-run CI or accept manual smoke sign-off + documented rollback. We need clear plan before merging.
Morgan Chen: Agree. If Ava approves and I +1, can we request an override? @Devops Bot will branch protection allow it?
Devops Bot: Merge blocked: branch protection requires 2 approvals and passing status checks. No override via chat. Manual remediation required or rerun CI.
Ava Patel: Left two small nits in the PR, nothing blocking. Will approve once John confirms CI flake or fix is pushed.
John Reyes: Found a timing bug in the test harness, pushed a fix (branch: fix/kv-flake) and retriggered CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/4722
CI Bot: build #4722 passed — all checks green :white_check_mark:
Sam Liu: OK excellent. @Ava @Morgan please give LGTM so we can merge before 18:00. If anything goes wrong we follow rollback script.
Ava Patel: LGTM :thumbsup:
Morgan Chen: LGTM. I'll coordinate the merge and monitor logs. @Devops Bot, schedule merge at next minute open for cutover.
Devops Bot: Merge scheduled by Morgan Chen at 18:05 UTC. Post-merge health checks will run for 15m.
Sam Liu: Cutover notes for on-call: rollback script is ops/runbooks/hotfix-2026.sh, alert channel #incidents. If errors > 5% tokens served, trigger rollback and notify infra.
Morgan Chen: Copy — will watch logs and escalate if needed. Thank you everyone :rocket:
